entry.title: New: BILL033(24) (Honolulu) — PUBLISH
entry.content:
RELATING TO CHAPTER 1, REVISED ORDINANCES OF HONOLULU 2021, AS AMENDED.

Amends Chapter 1, relating to the general provisions of the Revised Ordinances of Honolulu, to revise or repeal certain obsolete or unnecessary provisions.

Latest action: Final reading notice published in the Honolulu Star-Advertiser.
